SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.    File No.
S.I, Special Branch **〔此处转录不清〕**,
REPORT
Date October 11, 1939.

Subject. GRAY GEORGE HENRY.

Made by. D.S. Anderson,    Forwarded by **〔此处转录不清〕**

George H. Gray, registered at the British
Consulate, Shanghai on 12th May 1924. Enquiries
made at the Chinese Maritime Customs Statistical
Department reveal that Gray joined that service in
February 1924, as a 4th Class Tidewaiter, Revenue
Department, but later in August 1925, he transferred
to the Statistical Department in the capacity of
stock-keeper.

He resigned from the Customs Service in June
1928.

Between January 25th 1925 and April 11th 1933,
Gray was a member of the Shanghai Municipal Police
(Specials) during which time he was promoted to the
rank of Sergeant in charge of "D" Squad, 2nd Division.

Also, he served with the Shanghai Volunteer
Corps, in the machine gun Company, from the 12th
January till 25th of October 1927.

（批：Sir,
His work in
the Specials was very
unsatisfactory & he
never attended parades,
most of his time being
spent with the S.V.C.
**〔此处转录不清〕**）

A.S. Anderson
D. S.

D.C. (Special Branch).

上海公共租界工部局警务处。 档案编号
S.I，特务科 **〔此处转录不清〕**，
报告
日期：1939年10月11日。

事由：GRAY GEORGE HENRY（乔治·亨利·格雷）。

制作人：D.S. Anderson， 转呈人 **〔此处转录不清〕**

乔治·H·格雷（George H. Gray）于1924年5月12日在上海英国领事馆注册。向中国海关总署统计科查询获悉，格雷于1924年2月加入该机构，任职于税务处，职级为四等验货员（Tidewaiter），但随后于1925年8月调至统计科，担任库存管理员。

他于1928年6月从海关辞职。

在1925年1月25日至1933年4月11日期间，格雷是上海公共租界工部局警务处（特别警察队）的成员，在此期间，他晋升为警长，负责第二分区“D”小队。

此外，他还于1927年1月12日至10月25日期间，在上海万国商团机枪连服役。

（批注：先生，
他在特别警察队的工作
非常令人不满，且他
从未参加操练，
大部分时间都花在了万国商团。
**〔此处转录不清〕**）

A.S. Anderson
D. S.

副总监（特务科）。

POLICE DEPT QUEENSLAND.
24 SEP 1939 B 37151
COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE
QUEENSLAND POLICE.
CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION BRANCH.
BRISBANE, 21st September 1939.
165 P
7P
48727
URGENT.
Relative to : Accused George Henry GRAY, who stands committed for trial to the Criminal Sittings of the Supreme Court to be held at Brisbane on the 9th October 1939. Enquiries required at SHANGHAI, China.
B/C.
The Commissioner.
Forwarded. You may be pleased to cause this report to be forwarded to Shanghai Police by "AIR MAIL" for purpose of ascertaining if anything is known of George Henry Gray in that country.
〔签名〕
Sub-Inspector.
22. 9. 1939.
Airmail.
The Chief of Police,
Shanghai.
For favour of inquiry and report by air-mail please.
〔签名〕
Commissioner of Police,
Brisbane, Queensland.
22 Sept. 1939.
Sir,
I beg to report that the accused George Henry Gray is now committed for trial to the next criminal sittings of the Supreme Court to be held at Brisbane on the 9th October 1939, charged with Unlawful Assembly at Parliament House on the 4th August 1939.
The accused states that in 1924 he left Sydney, New South Wales and went to Shanghai, China, where he obtained a position in the Shanghai Customs, (Revenue Department) as a Custom Officer where he remained 2 years, after which he was transferred to the Statistical Department and remained in that Department for 22 years. During this time he states that he performed the duties of Public Prosecutor in the Customs Department.
He states that he later served 18 months with the Shanghai Volunteer Corps, and Shanghai Municipal Police Reserve. He states that he did garrison duty during the Civil War in Shanghai, and left China in 1930 and returned to Queensland.
Enquiries are desired in Shanghai, China, for the purpose of ascertaining if Gray's statements in regard to his position in the Customs Department and Military services are correct.
〔签名〕
Det. Constable 3182.
Submitted.
〔签名〕
Det. Sergt.

昆士兰州警察局。
1939年9月24日 B 37151
局长办公室
昆士兰警察。
刑事调查科。
布里斯班，1939年9月21日。
165 P
7P
48727
紧急。
关于：被告乔治·亨利·格雷（George Henry GRAY），其案件已移交定于1939年10月9日在布里斯班举行的最高法院刑事庭审进行审理。需在中国上海进行调查。
B/C.
致局长。
已转呈。请惠予将此报告通过“航空邮件”转发至上海警方，以便查明在该国是否有人知晓乔治·亨利·格雷的情况。
〔签名〕
副督察。
1939年9月22日。
航空邮件。
致上海警察局局长，
烦请调查并通过航空邮件回复。
〔签名〕
警察局长，
昆士兰州布里斯班。
1939年9月22日。
先生，
谨此报告，被告乔治·亨利·格雷的案件现已移交，将于1939年10月9日在布里斯班举行的下一次最高法院刑事庭审中受审，被控于1939年8月4日在议会大厦参与非法集会。
被告称，他于1924年离开新南威尔士州悉尼，前往中国上海，在那里获得了一份在上海海关（税务处）担任海关官员的职位，他在此任职2年，之后调至统计科，并在该科工作了22年。在此期间，他声称在海关部门履行公诉人的职责。
他声称后来在上海万国商团和上海公共租界工部局警务处后备队服役18个月。他声称在上海内战期间执行了卫戍任务，并于1930年离开中国返回昆士兰。
现希望在中国上海进行调查，以核实格雷关于其在海关部门的职位及军事服役情况的陈述是否属实。
〔签名〕
警探 3182号。
已呈报。
〔签名〕
警探警长。

CONFIDENTIAL
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.    File No. ____ 93
S.I., Special Branch.    ____ / 2
REPORT
Date ____ 10.1.38.
Subject. ____
Made by. D.J. Anderson,    Forwarded by. C Crawford V

George H. Gray, born at Hay, New South
Wales, Australia, in 1903, registered at the British
Consulate, Shanghai on 12th May 1924, and from
reliable sources it has been ascertained that he
departed from Shanghai for Dairen in 1934.
During his sojourn here, he was in the
employ of the Chinese Maritime Customs and later
engaged as a salesman with the firm of Gande, Price
Ltd., 31, Peking Road, wine and spirit merchants
from which firm he resigned in 1931.
On January 25th 1927 he joined the Shanghai
Municipal Police, Special Police, being detailed to
the 2nd Division, Squad A, and on October 24th 1928
was promoted to the rank of Sergeant in charge of
"B" Squad. He resigned from the Special Police on
April 11th 1933.

上海公共租界工部局警务处。 档案编号 ____ 93
S.I.，特务科。 ____ / 2
报告
日期 ____ 1938年1月10日。
事由： ____
制作人：D.J. Anderson， 转呈人：C Crawford V

乔治·H·格雷（George H. Gray），1903年出生于澳大利亚新南威尔士州海伊（Hay），于1924年5月12日在上海英国领事馆注册，据可靠消息来源获悉，他于1934年离开上海前往大连。
在华逗留期间，他受雇于中国海关，后来受聘于北京路31号的甘德·普赖斯有限公司（Gande, Price Ltd.，酒商），担任推销员，他于1931年从该公司辞职。
1927年1月25日，他加入上海公共租界工部局警务处特别警察队，被派往第二分区A小队，并于1928年10月24日晋升为警长，负责“B”小队。他于1933年4月11日从特别警察队辞职。

〔此处转录不清：左侧边缘有竖排手写汉字及底部有多处手写签名、批注与印章，包括 "FILE"、"D.S."、"A.S. Anderson." 等字样〕

副总监（特务科）。
